newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet slow, S.America, Africa interest help Med.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet slow, S.America, Africa interest help Med.

text.p: NWE jet premiums were under pressure on Monday in a continued quiet market, but the dip in outright prices was limited by stronger IPE gas oil futures.
April IPE gas oil was $1.00 a tonne stronger at $170.50 at 1630 GMT.
Jet barge premiums in NWE were heard talked down to April IPE gas oil +$17-19 fob ARA, while cif cargoes were around April IPE +$21-22.
Activity in the north was limited, with most of the market in discussion mode rather than trade mode, according to dealers.
The Mediterranean theatre was also finding the going a touch sluggish, but perkier than the north.
"I think some people are testing the water on prices in anticipation of some South American interest," said one dealer. Another commented that there was also some demand from Africa.
EC spec material was pegged at around fob high quotes +$8.50-9.00 although one seller was understood to be offering an "optimistic" +$12.
Libyian jet was holding steady around fob high quotes +$5.
